verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a served llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt with agent-directed guidance, and markdown renderings of doc pages (payments.md). The docs also include agent-oriented material: a keyless /.well-known/skills index of SKILL.md files, copy-paste prompts telling coding agents to 'Read …/mpp.md', and an MCP documentation-search tool. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs, and the full llms.txt structure and coverage (probe content is truncated).
